scripts.predev: npm run build -w @littlefootprints/shared && lsof -ti:3002 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:5174 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; echo 'Ports cleaned'
scripts.dev: npm run predev && echo '🚀 LittleFootprints 后端 http://localhost:3002 · 前端 http://localhost:5174' && npm run dev:server & npm run dev:web & wait
scripts.test: npm run build -w @littlefootprints/shared && npm test --workspace=packages/server && npm test --workspace=packages/web
